question: Across the already-frozen complete deterministic-first equal-prior collision class, does the J9A affine parity-character mechanism replay every direct action-conditioned public law, and do coarse parity ranks suffice to classify the heterogeneous pairwise contrasts?
fork_classification: Exact character replay, affine-support reconstruction, and rank-pair collision checks are independent reversible diagnostics using the same 48 previously computed laws. Their combined maximum 3,072 operator products and five CPU seconds are within the inherited local budget; evaluate every branch of the fixed 12-sector/two-action matrix rather than ranking them for a human.
model_boundary: R6AF ideal periodic L=2 D4 public instrument, p_X=1/10, p_Z=0, all-zero-charge deterministic complete first record, the J8X 12 double-support three-edge flux sectors, both equal-prior private errors per sector, and the same two relation-free public charge actions. Private errors are analysis-only; the action and second public record are fixed independently of them.

hypotheses.affine_replay: For every one of the 48 direct second laws, all active-charge parity moments equal the orbit-operator characters and the law is uniform on the affine subspace defined by its deterministic parity constraints; the positive and null contrasts are classified by their actual signed constraints.
hypotheses.rank_only_pooling: The pair of parity-constraint ranks alone determines the pairwise complete-law TV across all 24 sector/action cells.
hypotheses.rank_only_rejected: At least one repeated rank pair has different direct TVs, so coarse rank-only pooling is invalid even though full signed-character replay may pass.
hypotheses.censored: Any source, action/flux, first-record, eligibility, commutation, moment, affine support, normalization, law-replay, budget or hash gate fails; no partial generalization is promoted.

matrix.cells: All 12 J8X sectors times both fixed actions. For each pair, derive at most six active public-charge coordinates from the union of the two stored complete laws, check all outside coordinates fixed identically, and enumerate every active-site parity character under both errors. Replay every moment against the direct public law; construct an independent GF(2) basis of deterministic signed parity constraints; replay each uniform affine support and full pairwise TV. Report positive minimum differing parity order and whether rank-pair classes collide across distinct TVs. Include null controls; do not select sectors after observing outputs.
matrix.independent_unit: One exact sector/action/error law; 48 laws and 24 matched pairwise contrasts, no stochastic sample or sampling uncertainty.
matrix.integrity: Pin J8X direct laws, J9A finite positive control, geometry/orbit and operator/composition/public-law source hashes. Check 24 deterministic first records, identical first/second flux within each pair, action-bound residual, second eligibility, commutation and involution, exact orbit/public parity equality, uniform affine support, full-law TV replay, positive-control replay, CPU cap and zero new Born/history/arm/bootstrap work.

acceptance: All 48 direct second laws replay from exact active-site orbit characters and signed affine supports or the attempted reduction is explicitly censored
All 24 pairwise TVs and every null/positive cell replay; rank-only pooling supported or rejected from the frozen complete class, with a minimum differing parity order for positive cells
No cross-sector operator automorphism, uncomputed public-law reuse, full-IID information/risk, noisy JIT, scaling or threshold claim
stop_rule: Stop after all 12 frozen sectors times two actions and at most 3,072 exact operator-character checks, or first integrity/five-CPU-second failure. No new sectors, first records, private errors, actions, Born laws, histories or budget expansion.
